intro: Uraveda Shine is a gentle ayurvedic brightening oil designed for delicate zones like underarms and bikini area. With regular use, it helps reduce the appearance of darkness, improves texture, and calms irritation caused by shaving or friction, leaving skin soft and even‑looking. The non‑greasy formula is easy to add to everyday care; results vary by skin type and consistency. This is a cosmetic product without bleaching agents.

li: Ayurvedic oil formulated to help lighten the look of dark underarm and intimate areas for a more even tone.
Targets spots and pigmentation while soothing redness and irritation from shaving or friction.
Lightweight, fast‑absorbing texture for daily use; leaves a smooth, non‑sticky finish.
Helps control odor by supporting clean, balanced skin; suitable for most skin types.
30 ml dropper bottle for precise application and hygienic use.
After cleansing, pat dry and apply 2–3 drops; massage until absorbed. Use twice daily for 8–12 weeks.
Avoid immediately after shaving/waxing; patch test first on inner arm for 24 hours.
1 x Uraveda Shine Oil, 30 ml dropper bottle
Adults looking for ayurvedic care for underarm/intimate area pigmentation, soothing, and odor control.
External use only; avoid mucosal contact and broken skin; discontinue if irritation occurs.
Cosmetic/ayurvedic skincare; no medical or bleaching claims; store cool and dry.
